Khaṇḍadeva
of Benares; known also a. Deva; son of Rudradeva; pupil of Viśveśvara an. teacher of Peru Bhaṭṭa (father of Jagannātha Paṇḍita, a. of Rasagaṅgādhara) an. Śambhu Bhaṭṭa (a. of C. Prabhāvalī on Bhāṭṭadīpikā an. Kālatattvavivecanasārasaṅgraha); flourished in the middle of the 17th [Page174-a. Cent. A. D. On the chronology of his works see P. K. Gode, D. R. Bhandarkar Volume, p.. 9-15. According to Śambhu Bhaṭṭa (C. Prabhāvalī), Khaṇḍadeva lived in Brahmanāla a. Benares an. died in 1665-6 A. D. a. a saṁnyāsin, his saṁnyāsa name being Śrīdharendra.
